name: lazyspec
description: A project's OpenSpec specifications and changes: read, find, refine, clarify, investigate the code, and save as a pull request.
long_description: LazySpec gives Claude a project's OpenSpec: the specifications (openspec/specs/) and the changes (openspec/changes/) with their proposal, delta specs, design and tasks. Claude reads, finds, edits and ticks them; main specs are changed through a change, as OpenSpec wants; out-of-date documents are shown; everything since the last commit can be undone; the work is saved as a pull request (openspec/ only). The code is read-only, to investigate what the system does today. Documents for the client go to openspec/exports/ in the company look. Made by Netmedia.

projects.title: Projects folder
projects.description: The folder with your projects' git repositories (GitHub Desktop clones into Documents/GitHub). LazySpec finds every project with an openspec/ folder in it, up to three levels down.
